newsitem.title: USA: MSB Bancorp Inc Q1 shr $0.23 vs $0.12.
newsitem.headline: MSB Bancorp Inc Q1 shr $0.23 vs $0.12.

text.p: (All data above 000s except per share numbers)
NOTES: Q1 1997 includes legal and other costs of $110,000 related to an employee litigatino matter settled in Q1.

Q1 1997 net interest income was $6,080 000, up from $5,549,000 in 1996 Q1. Net interest income after the provision for loan losses amounted to $5.8 million for Q1 1997, up from $5.3 million in Q1 1996.
The company's total assets at March 31, 1997 were $810.7 million, compared with $820.9 million at December 31, 1996.
